propositions: The documented curl command to install the commit-msg hook resolves to the shared hooks directory when run from a linked worktree, silently overwriting the pre-commit wrapper and breaking Change-Id stamping across all worktrees on the host.

The unsafe installation clobbers the pre-commit migration chain, disabling both the 50/72 message linting gate and the Gerrit Change-Id stamper, with failures only surfacing later at push time in a different worktree.

The fix consolidates hook installation into make hooks with a new idempotent scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh that detects pre-commit wrappers and installs to commit-msg.legacy instead, refusing unsafe overwrites.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove documentation of the bare curl command and point to make hooks as the single documented installation path.
The installer must validate the fetched payload contains Change-Id logic and refuse installation of corrupted or HTML error responses.
